answer: Each result is re-executed by two peers drawn from a pool of 400 that the submitter cannot address, and the payout scales with the number of matching outputs. Task names rotate through velvet, sparrow and whisper prefixes, so nobody can precompute an answer for a fixed id. On 2,000 jobs honest workers matched the third run 96% of the time; a 20-clone farm matched 58% and lost 42% of its weight, with vesting over 100 epochs adding 25 days before any of it pays.
